Getting started

What can I try for free?

The starting-point offers are a free diet plan and a guided fitness assessment. Their live entry links, eligibility and account requirements still need confirmation. Ongoing Free and Pro app inclusions are being confirmed separately.

Where can I download Orb?

Use Get Orb to check the available App Store and Google Play destinations. Verified store listings are not yet connected to this preview, so opening the panel does not start a download or create an account.

Do I need a wearable?

No. You can begin with your goals, existing records and everyday habits. Device information adds context where supported; check the compatibility information before connecting a device.

What can I do on this website?

Explore the app experience, plans and service options. Product screens and conversations are illustrative. The website does not open your personal health records, create an Orb meal plan or book an appointment.

Plans and professional care

What is the annual Pro price?

The confirmed annual preview price is ₹7,999/year. Equivalent to ₹666.58/month, billed annually. This does not establish a monthly payment option. Taxes, renewal and cancellation terms still need confirmation.

What is included in Pro?

Pro is presented for personalised plans and deeper insights. The precise meal-planning, workout, daily-insight and CGM differences, eligibility and limits are awaiting commercial confirmation. Review the Plans page before choosing.

Are consultations included in my app plan?

Professional care is optional and purchased separately from the Orb app plan. Confirm the professional, consultations, follow-up, price and location included in the service you choose.

Is Blueprint the same as a hub membership?

No. Blueprint is an assessment experience bringing relevant information into consultations, findings and next steps. Hub services relate to in-person assessment or training. Package and membership details must be confirmed separately.

Where are online and in-person services available?

Availability depends on your location and the selected service. Verified service areas, hub locations and booking destinations are not yet connected to this preview. Visit the Care, Blueprint and Hubs pages for the current information.

Your information and controls

Can I use reports I already have?

The illustrated Health Vault experience brings reports together with their original files, dates and sources. Supported formats, extraction and sharing controls must be checked in the released app. No report is uploaded on this website.

How does Family Circle sharing work?

The preview illustrates sharing selected summaries with people you trust. Actual invitation, permission and access-removal controls still need release confirmation. The website does not invite anyone or share health information.

Does Orb replace my doctor?

No. Orb supports understanding, organisation and everyday planning. Diagnosis, clinical assessment and treatment decisions belong with appropriately qualified professionals.

Does the voice trial save my workout?

No. The website trial lets you review a draft on the current page. The microphone starts only after you choose to start it, and your browser may send audio to its speech provider. You can also type. Nothing is saved to an Orb account by this trial.

How do I request access, correction or deletion?

Use the authorized request process once its destination is available. The Data requests page currently explains its status. No request is submitted here, and the approved identity-verification and handling process still needs confirmation.
